21:   // ---- Input ----

23:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.code]=false);

26:     if(gameOver) return;
27:     // ship controls

29:     if(keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle+=0.003*dt;
30:     if(keys['ArrowUp']){ // thrust
31:       ship.vx+=Math.cos(ship.angle)*0.001*dt;
32:       ship.vy+=Math.sin(ship.angle)*0.001*dt;
33:     }

35:     ship.x+=ship.vx*dt; ship.y+=ship.vy*dt;
36:     // screen wrap
37:     if(ship.x<0) ship.x+=W; if(ship.x>W) ship.x-=W;
38:     if(ship.y<0) ship.y+=H; if(ship.y>H) ship.y-=H;
39: 
40:     // spawn asteroids

42:       const angle=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
43:       const speed=0.05+Math.random()*0.1;
44:       asteroids.push({
45:         x:Math.random()*W,
46:         y:Math.random()*H,
47:         vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,
48:         vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,
49:         r:15+Math.random()*20,
50:         ttl:0 // unused
51:       });
52:       lastAsteroid=Date.now();
53:       // increase difficulty
54:       if(asteroidSpawn>500) asteroidSpawn-=50;
55:     }
56:     // spawn orbs
57:     if(Date.now()-lastOrb>orbSpawn){
58:       orbs.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:5,ttl:10000});
59:       lastOrb=Date.now();
60:     }
61: 
62:     // update asteroids
63:     for(let a of asteroids){
64:       a.x+=a.vx*dt; a.y+=a.vy*dt;
65:       if(a.x<0) a.x+=W; if(a.x>W) a.x-=W;
66:       if(a.y<0) a.y+=H; if(a.y>H) a.y-=H;
67:     }
68:     // update orbs ttl
69:     for(let i=orbs.length-1;i>=0;i--){
70:       const o=orbs[i];
71:       o.ttl-=dt; if(o.ttl<=0) orbs.splice(i,1);
72:     }
73: 
74:     // collisions ship-asteroid
75:     for(let a of asteroids){
76:       const dx=ship.x-a.x, dy=ship.y-a.y;
77:       const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
78:       if(dist<ship.r+a.r){gameOver=true; break;}
79:     }
80:     // ship-orb collection
81:     for(let i=orbs.length-1;i>=0;i--){
82:       const o=orbs[i];

87:     }
88:     // score based on time
89:     score=Math.floor((Date.now()-start)/1000)+orbScore;
90:   }
91: 
92:   function draw(){

95:     ctx.save();

97:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
98:     ctx.beginPath();

101:     ctx.lineTo(-8,-6);
102:     ctx.closePath();

106:     // asteroids

122:     ctx.font='16px monospace';

127:       ctx.fillText('Game Over',W/2,H/2);
128:     }
129:   }

137:   }

139: })();
